nodes.label: Antiforgery CSRF Protection
nodes.rationale: Cookie auth is ambient, so cookie-authenticated mutations need antiforgery tokens; bearer clients are not CSRF-susceptible.

nodes.label: App Roles ChaosViewer ChaosOperator ChaosAdmin
nodes.rationale: Three roles rather than overloading ChaosOperator for administration.

nodes.label: Data-Plane Authentication
nodes.rationale: Directive polling uses separate per-service credentials and must not accept operator tokens.

nodes.label: Trusted Audit Identity
nodes.rationale: Actor derived from Entra oid/sub claims, never request JSON.

nodes.label: Milestone 4 Service Registry and Experiment Lifecycle
nodes.norm_label: milestone 4 service registry and experiment lifecycle

nodes.label: Milestone 7 Delivery Pipeline and Hosted Demo
nodes.norm_label: milestone 7 delivery pipeline and hosted demo

nodes.label: Target Architecture
nodes.rationale: Control plane issues directives and never performs disruptive work in its own process.

nodes.label: Prioritized First Release
nodes.rationale: Milestones 1-3 plus Latency/HttpFailure of Milestone 5 then Milestone 7 is the smallest coherent deployable release.

nodes.label: CpuSpike Fault
nodes.rationale: Recorded by API but not executed by the sample service.

nodes.label: Experiment Lease
nodes.rationale: Leases 1-3600 s (default 300) bound how long a fault can stay active.

nodes.label: TriggeredBy Anonymous Identity
nodes.rationale: Caller-supplied TriggeredBy is ignored; server records anonymous until auth exists.

nodes.label: Defence in Depth Safety Model
nodes.rationale: Validation at domain, orchestrator, DB constraint, lease expiry and unfaulted health paths so no single check is relied on.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Safety Claim
nodes.rationale: A target never receives an out-of-bounds directive and never has two active experiments.

nodes.label: Global Kill Switch
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator checks the kill switch before writing, not only the HTTP handler.

nodes.label: Step 0 CI and Quality Gates
nodes.rationale: Lock files deferred because SDK implicit packages vary across SDK patches.

nodes.label: Favicon: purple swirl with white @ symbol
nodes.norm_label: favicon: purple swirl with white @ symbol

nodes.label: Data-Plane Behavior
nodes.rationale: Monotonic TimeProvider local lease prevents clock skew from extending a fault.

nodes.label: Automatic Lease Expiry
nodes.rationale: Control-plane outage cannot extend a fault because both sides treat expired directives as inactive.

nodes.label: Persistence and Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Reads enforce active-and-unexpired rule so expired faults stop immediately even before cleanup runs.

nodes.label: Partial Unique Constraint
nodes.rationale: Prevents two active experiments per target even under concurrent requests.
